response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Eh? My maps? There's honestly not much to be said about them. Before I joined the Adventurers' Guild, I was the mine cartographer.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Of course, I wasn't just some person sitting behind a desk... In fact, we couldn't be more different.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I was once commissioned by them to map out the terrain of Qiaoying Village... and after all that work, they canceled the construction project just like that, with only a word.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: People like them get assistants to do the dirty exploration work and information-gathering for them, and then they start drawing... But those like me? We can't do that.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: As... well, half a miner myself, I've long gotten used to passing through the dangerous underground passages. It's just the way the job works.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Also, after that great change, the lower levels of The Chasm have really been truly unstable.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Unstable? Is that very dangerous?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: You bet it is. The terrain here is slowly but constantly changing. A path today might be a rock wall next month. It's almost as if... How should I say this...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: It's almost as if The Chasm itself is changing shape as it likes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... things can't be that spooky, right?

choices.text: Tell me about your life as an adventurer.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Haha, what? My "life"? You don't have to be so polite. I'm just a newbie. I've barely started my journey, unlike you.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I have completed some commissions from the Guild, of course, but I'm not that experienced yet, so I haven't done much solo exploration. I don't think I've left any tales of my deeds behind either...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: So I've been thinking that The Chasm might be just the place for me to make my mark for future generations to remember me by.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: The Chasm might be, to quote the great adventurer Alice, my "Rubicon"!

choices.text: The Rubicon... is that hilichurl language?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's never heard of that one either...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, I'm not too sure myself, but given that Alice is an adventurer who has seen the entire world, so that must be some place she's been to... right?

choices.text: Your Rubicon, huh? That's pretty impressive.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, you don't even know what that is!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Haha, regardless, thanks for your encouragement!

choices.text: What do you think about Clitopho?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Him? I don't trust him. We've had to deal with the Treasure Hoarders above the mines for who-knows how long. They're up to no good. I know it!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Don't you trust a word that he says. Turning over a new leaf... Washing his hands of the situation...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: While they say such pretty words, they'll be reaching their filthy hands into your back pocket.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Even Rex Lapis would have trouble protecting your wallet from them then!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I'm not prejudiced or anything... I'm just telling you to be wary. The Treasure Hoarders are never to be trusted.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That does sound like prejudice to me, though.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: ...Maybe it is. You've probably seen a great many more things than I have, so I guess you might be more generous to them. But as for me, I'll always keep an eye at the back of my head, just for them.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: And I'll keep doing that until this guy can prove that he's got nothing more to do with those despicable "former" companions of his.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: See you!
